name: Roasted Tomato, Onion & Mozzarella Flatbread with Arugula-Caper Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Place oven racks in the upper, middle, and lower positions.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces; halve tomatoes. Transfer both to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet on the upper rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies soften, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, divide flatbreads between two baking sheets. Place on the middle and lower racks and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
While the flatbreads are baking, juice lemons into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; mince capers. Add both to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp capers
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the veggies are done, sprinkle mozzarella over the flatbreads; top with the roasted veggies and half of the basil. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Return flatbreads to the oven and bake until warmed through and cheese is melted, 5-6 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and bell pepper; toss to combine the salad.
Slice flatbreads, divide between plates, and sprinkle with reserved basil. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
